title: What a Schema Is For Level C2
success_criteria: Names the actor, object, operation, and boundary being changed or reviewed.
Uses targeted PostgreSQL GRANT, REVOKE, ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES, ownership, schema, or search_path syntax as appropriate.
Includes catalog or information_schema evidence suitable for an access review.
oral_defense_prompts: Which privilege would be dangerous if granted directly to a login role?
What catalog query proves the repair worked after deployment?
